recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed; any future TestReport wording maintenance should happen in the FHIR Testing IG.
issue_request: FHIR-36266 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for R5 asking that TestReport.identifier and TestReport.name refer to the TestReport itself rather than incorrectly saying TestScript.
initial_application: PR HL7/fhir#1768 and commit 7c18d5d967064b243fc662d289aaf171b229df87 changed source/testreport/structuredefinition-TestReport.xml so TestReport.identifier and TestReport.name use TestReport wording. The checked R5 history contains the corrected wording.
additional_context: Current core no longer owns the TestReport resource definition. Commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed source/testreport and active TestReport/TestScript fhir.ini entries; source/fhir.ini points to the FHIR Testing IG as an additional IG, and source/ballot-intro.html links TestReport there. Older tools/history release4/release4b snapshots retain the historical pre-R5 wording and are not current build source.
reconciliation: No core source was edited. The published audit commit records that FHIR-36266 is already reflected where it was applied for R5 and that the currently maintained TestReport artifact is external to the core checkout and already corrected.
